content.body:
The Bf109F-4 was an improved model over previous versions. It boasted a yet again higher climb rate and top speed, in addition to the new MG151 higher velocity electrically fired 20 mm cannon replacing the older low velocity MGFF/M type. It's a little heavier again than its predecessors, so as is usual with aircraft it doesn't turn quite as briskly but it's still a very good turn fighter if the pilot knows how to get the most out of his airframe.
The new MG151/20 cannon was belt fed (the earlier MGFF cannons were drum fed) and thus the new "Franz" carried a better than 3 fold increase in 20mm ammunition with 200 rounds.
content.brief: TYPE: Fighter Interceptor MAX. SPEED: 635 km/h WEIGHT: 2,811 kg CREW: 1 ARMAMENT: 20 mm MG151/20 Cannon (1) 7.92 mm MG17 LMGs (2)
